additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437391-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R4 170001719] Display damaged CRM:02919000164
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Hope you are doing well.
Issue Description:
The HMI screen of the charger shows visible signs of physical damage, including cracking and surface separation. The damage appears to be consistent with delamination, which may affect the touch functionality and visibility of the display.
Visual Evidence:
Attached image clearly shows the extent of the damage. The screen is visibly cracked and reflective distortions are present, indicating compromised surface integrity.
Recommended Action:
HMI Replacement is needed due to the severity of the damage.
Delamination should be noted as the root cause or contributing factor.
Further inspection required to ensure no internal components are affected.
Additional Notes:
The charger is currently marked as out of service ("Außer Betrieb"), and should remain offline until the HMI is replaced and functionality is restored.
